text.en:
The Allocation formula for determining the individual shares of the local governments effective
July 1, 1976 as provided for in Sections 1, 2 and 3 in relation with Section 4 of Presidential Decree No. 144,
as amended by Presidential Decree No. 559 and Section 22, paragraph (c) of Presidential Decree No. 898, is
hereby modified and, for the purpose, Section 4 of Presidential Decree No. 144 is hereby amended to read in
full as follows:
"4. (a) For the first three fiscal years of implementation of this Decree FY's 1974, 1975 and 1976, the annual
allotment of any local government shall not increase by more than fifteen per centum (15%) nor decrease by
more than fifty per centum (50%) of its allotment during the fiscal year 1970-71.
(a) For the six-month period from July 1, 1976 to December 31, 1976, the internal revenue allotment of any
local government shall not increase by more than twenty-five per centum (25%) of, nor be less than, the
allotment it actually received for the six-month period from July 1, 1975 to December 31, 1975, as determined
pursuant to Section 1, 2, and 3 hereof.
(b) For the new fiscal year commencing on January 1, 1977 and ending on December 31, 1977, the annual
allotment of any local government as determined pursuant to Sections 1, 2 and 3 hereof shall not increase by
more than twenty-five per centum (25%) of, nor be less than, the annual allotment it shall actually receive for
the fiscal year from July 1, 1975 to June 30, 1976.
(c) Thereafter, or beginning January 1, 1978, the annual allotment shares of each local government shall be
determined solely on the basis of Section 1, 2, and 3 hereof as read in relation with the pertinent provisions of
Presidential Decree Nos. 559 and 898."

The Secretary of Finance shall issue the rules and regulations necessary for the Proper

implementation of this Decree.

All laws, decrees, orders, and rules and regulations or parts thereof, which are contrary to or
inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree, except as otherwise provided for herein, shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
